propositions: Bare `import alert_dedup` in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py resolves only when scripts/ is on sys.path, causing ModuleNotFoundError when test file runs standalone but passing in full CI due to process-wide side effects from conftest.py
Subset test runs fail with ModuleNotFoundError while CI passes, creating discrepancy that trains developers to distrust the test suite

Fix requires explicit sys.path insert derived from __file__ immediately above each bare sibling import, following the established pattern in scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py, as alternative solutions (relative imports, making scripts/ a package) have unacceptable production blast radius

New guard test scripts/test_scripts_import_convention.py uses AST scanning and subprocess execution to verify that all bare imports of sibling modules are preceded by sys.path inserts and that affected tests collect when run standalone
